title: Special Executive Programme In Commercial Trust Law
description: Gain a comprehensive understanding of the principles, types, and commercial applications of Trust Law.
longDescription: This programme delves into the historical context, principles, and evolution of Trusts, focusing on their commercialisation. Participants will explore trust structures across different jurisdictions and the legal frameworks governing them.
courseDetails: The course begins by examining the fundamental principles of Equity and the development of Trust Law, followed by a detailed analysis of various types of trusts and the rights and obligations involved. It will also explore the growing trend of commercialising trusts and its impact on the legal and business sectors. Participants will study the relationship between Trusts and contracts, differentiating between them, and examine how trust laws vary across jurisdictions.
